title: Federated learning for unpaired multimodal data
abstract: arXiv:2601.17986v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training of multimodal foundation models is currently restricted to centralized data centers containing massive, aligned datasets (e.g., image-text pairs). However, in realistic federated environments, data is often unpaired and fragmented across disjoint nodes; one node may hold sensor data, while another holds textual logs. These datasets are strictly private and share no common samples. Current federated learning (FL) methods fail in this regime, as they assume local clients possess aligned pairs or require sharing raw feature embeddings, which violates data sovereignty. We propose a novel framework to train a global multimodal transformer across decentralized nodes with disjoint modalities. We introduce a small public anchor set to align disjoint private manifolds. translated_title: 面向非配对多模态数据的联邦学习
translated_abstract: 多模态基础模型的训练目前仅限于拥有海量对齐数据集（例如图文对）的集中式数据中心。然而，在现实的联邦环境中，数据通常是非配对的，且分散在互不相交的节点上；一个节点可能持有传感器数据，而另一个节点持有文本日志。这些数据集严格私有，彼此不共享任何共同样本。当前的联邦学习（FL）方法在这种情形下会失效，因为它们假设本地客户端拥有对齐的数据对，或者需要共享原始特征嵌入，这违反了数据主权。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，用于在模态不相交的去中心化节点上训练一个全局多模态Transformer。我们引入一个小的公共锚点集来对齐不相交的私有流形。利用从这些公共锚点计算得到的Gram矩阵，我们通过中心核对齐（CKA）在模态之间实现语义对齐，而无需传输任何私有数据。
tldr: 提出一种基于小型公共锚点集和中心核对齐（CKA）的联邦学习框架，在无需共享私有特征的前提下，实现跨模态不相交的去中心化节点的全局多模态Transformer训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes a federated learning framework that uses a small public anchor set with centered kernel alignment (CKA) to train a global multimodal transformer across decentralized nodes with disjoint modalities, without ever transmitting private data.
